content: That is, we want the expected extrinsic reward $\mathcal {L}^{ex}(\mathbf {\theta }^{\prime })$ of the new policy $\mathbf {\theta }^{\prime }$ to be maximized. Since $\mathbf {\theta }^{\prime }$ is a function of $\mathbf {\phi }$, we can directly backpropagate the gradient through $\mathbf {\theta }^{\prime }$ to $\mathbf {\phi }$.
